title: A messenger calls for help
story: A messenger runs up to the Bahay ng Datu, out of breath: warriors from {enemy} are sailing to raid {neighbor}. {datu} asks you to send defenders before they land.

choices.label: Send warriors to stand with them
choices.result: Your Mandirigma run to {neighbor}'s shore to fight beside them.

choices.label: Keep our warriors home
choices.result: {neighbor} meets {enemy} alone. {datu} will remember who came and who did not.

sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
